Item Class: Skill Gems
Rarity: Gem
Frost Wall
--------
Spell, Duration, Cold
Level: 1
Cost: 9 Mana
Cooldown Time: 3.00 sec (3 uses)
Cast Time: 0.50 sec
--------
Requirements:
Level: 4
Int: 16
--------
Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.
--------
Deals 8 to 12 Cold Damage
Base duration is 3.00 seconds
0.2 seconds between appearance of Wall sections
Wall will be 2.8 meters long
--------
Experience: 1/841
--------
Place into an item socket to gain this skill. Right click to remove from a socket.
